title: Ordinary constant tensor compatibility for the finite coefficient layer
statement: For an adic coefficient datum with compatible coefficient isomorphisms, the ordinary functor taking a residue module P to its constant realization tensored on the right with the constant ideal-power layer, then restricted to the successor coefficient sheaf, is naturally isomorphic to the constant realization at the successor level of the algebraic functor P |-> (I^(n+1)/(I I^(n+1))) tensor_(A/I) P, with scalars restricted along A/I^(n+2) -> A/I. The assertion is in abelian module categories and requires no boundedness, projectivity, or flatness.

source.place: Tag 094I, lemma-locally-constant-bounded, ideal-layer tensor argument; Modules on Sites, Tags 03CY and 03EL

proof.text: The lifted pure-tensor equivalence identifies ULift(P tensor L) with ULift(P) tensor ULift(L). Constant module realization is strong monoidal. Ordinary extension of scalars has the balanced tensor comparison, so their composite carries P tensor L to C(P) tensor C(L), naturally in P.

Constant realization commutes with restriction of scalars along the algebraic quotient map. Its proof uses the constant module sheafification unit: locally both modules are generated by the same constant sections, with the same scalar action. Cancel the constant quotient map from A in the scalar compatibility equation to identify the successor-to-residue coefficient square.

Transport this square through extension along the coefficient isomorphisms, and apply tensor symmetry to exchange P and the layer. The naturality squares commute on pure tensors and hence on their sheafifications. This yields an isomorphism of ordinary functors; the zero layer, zero ring and empty site use the same universal properties.

theorem finiteQuotient_layer_ordinary_tensor_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ k : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (k + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d k)
    (hφ : ∀ k : ℕ, IsIso (φ k))
    (hc : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d 0)
    Nonempty
      (finiteCoefficientConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1)) (φ 0) ⋙
          MonoidalCategory.tensorRight
            ((finiteCoefficientConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1)) (φ 0)).obj
              (finiteQuotientLayerModule d.ideal n)) ⋙
          SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
            ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
              (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).map
                (completedAdicQuotientCommMap X d (n + 1) 0 (Nat.zero_le _))) ≅
        finiteQuotientLayerTensor d.ideal n ⋙
          finiteCoefficientConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)) (φ (n + 1)))
